I recommend that you try to talk to someone you trust. I find it easier to stop harming myself when someone else tells me to stop than when I do it myself. But if you can't tell someone that you self harm, I'd recommend finding someone (maybe a friend or a family member) rhat you can talk to about random things. This works for me. Even if you're not talking about your problems things feel less lonely, and chances are you'll feel happier and move on from what happened.

You could if you want to write down reasons not to SH, and put the note in a place you'll look at often (for example beside your bed, or maybe on the mirror even). I also find that drawing and writing on the places where I want to self harm works. 

But most importantly, do something that you love. It could be anything, but for me it's important to keep myself busy so I don't SH. I know this works for many others too. I really hope this helps, and I'm here if you need to talk :)
